name: attention-panel
description: Side pane listing the action items in the current project that need your attention

file.title: Action items file
file.description: Path of the JSON list, relative to the project root (an absolute path also works)

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude when you answer
tellClaude.description: After you accept or reject a recommendation in the pane, send Claude a short prompt so it acts on your answer straight away

instructClaude.title: Tell Claude to keep the list
instructClaude.description: Add a short instruction to Claude's system prompt and give it two tools (attention_add, attention_resolve), so the list is kept in every project without a line in CLAUDE.md

autoCapture.title: Ask Claude automatically when an ask is missed
autoCapture.description: When Claude's answer asks you for something and the list did not change, send Claude a short prompt to list it. Off: the pane shows a line with a button instead
